Seller ($170): Generous?! You are trying to starve me on the sidewalk with your pathetic $120! I said $170 and I meant $170, so pay the cash or take a hike right now!

Buyer ($130): You must be delusional if you think anyone is paying $170 for a phone with a degraded battery and a scratched screen. I am pulling out my absolute final $130 cash right now, which is far more than this junk is worth. Take $130 this second or I am walking away forever!

Seller ($170): One hundred thirty?! Are you blind, deaf, and completely crazy?! I am already bleeding out on the pavement at 170, and you throw pocket change in my face! Pay the $170 right now or beat it before I lose my mind!
Buyer ($130): That is my final offer and I am not paying a single penny more for this outdated junk. Take the $130 right now or I am walking away permanently.
Seller ($170): Then walk away! You think you can intimidate me into giving away my hardware for $130? Pay my $170 right now or get out of my face forever!
